file_impact.reason: calls os.path.relpath/relative_to across a store root and a working tree; on Windows those can sit on different drives (the runner has the checkout on D: and TEMP on C:), where relpath raises ValueError instead of returning an answer -- needs a defined fallback per call site

same relpath-across-roots shape; a caller that requires a repo-relative path needs different handling from one merely shortening a path for display, so the no-common-root behaviour must be chosen and tested per site
computes repo-relative paths for metric rows; a ValueError here aborts a metrics run rather than degrading it
